dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a shallow angular slope of approximately 30 degrees relative to the primary horizontal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum horizontal pixel base to the vertical pixel height is approximately 2.2:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The visible dorsal cranial boundary displays a high-radius convexity, representing a shallow, elongated melon arc.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of distinct, dark, ovoid pigmentation patches are horizontally aligned along the lower lateral flank, ventral to the dorsal fin position.
